# BuildPCBs AI

> High-performance hardware manufacturing powered by AI.
> Design, simulate, validate, and ship production-ready PCBs in record time.

## Documentation & FAQ

### Getting Started
- **What is BuildPCBs AI?**
  An automated platform that bridges the gap between PCB design (EDA) and physical manufacturing using AI-driven DFM (Design for Manufacturing) analysis.
- **How do I start a project?**
  Upload your Gerber files (RS-274X or X2) and your Bill of Materials (BOM) to our dashboard for an instant AI-powered audit.
- **Is there a Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?**
  No. We support everything from a single prototype to mass production runs. Pricing scales dynamically with volume.

### Technical Specifications & DFM
- **What are the minimum trace/space requirements?**
  Our standard process supports down to 3mil/3mil. For advanced HDI requirements, please contact our engineering team via the dashboard.
- **What file formats are supported?**
  We natively support Gerber, ODB++, and direct imports from common EDA tools like KiCad, Altium, and Figma (via our vector-to-PCB plugin).
- **How do you handle impedance control?**
  Provide your target values (single-ended/differential) in your design notes. Our AI field solvers simulate the stack-up to ensure signal integrity before fabrication.
- **What surface finishes are available?**
  We offer HASL (Lead-free), ENIG (Gold), OSP, and Immersion Silver. ENIG is recommended for fine-pitch BGA components.
- **Can I use 90-degree trace bends?**
  While supported, our AI DFM will suggest 45-degree bends to reduce impedance discontinuities and EMI radiation in high-speed designs.

### Manufacturing & Assembly (PCBA)
- **Do you offer assembly (PCBA)?**
  Yes. We provide full-turnkey assembly, including component sourcing and "Box Build" enclosure services.
- **What is a Centroid/Pick-and-Place file?**
  This file contains the X/Y coordinates, rotation, and side (Top/Bottom) for every component. It is required for all automated assembly orders.
- **How do you handle component attrition?**
  For customer-provided parts, please include 3-5% extra for small SMT components (0402, 0603) to account for assembly machine waste.
- **What is the lead time?**
  Prototypes typically ship within 2-4 days. Full PCBA orders depend on component lead times, usually ranging from 5-14 business days.

### The $BUILDers Ecosystem
- **What is the Anti-Rug Dashboard?**
  A transparency layer for the $BUILD token that tracks liquidity locks and project milestones in real-time.
- **How does vesting work?**
  You can check your specific "Vesting Status" directly under the $BUILDers tab to see your unlocked token allocation.

### API & Integration
- **Is there a BuildPCBs API?**
  Yes. You can programmatically trigger quotes, check order status, and upload design files.
- **How is authentication handled?**
  Authentication uses Bearer tokens. Generate your API key in the Developer Settings of your dashboard.
- **Can I integrate with CI/CD?**
  Absolutely. Many teams use our API to trigger a "Manufacturing Preview" every time they push a new hardware revision to GitHub.

### Quality & Compliance
- **What certifications do you hold?**
  Our facilities are ISO9001 and IATF16949 certified. All boards meet IPC-A-600 Class 2 standards by default (Class 3 available upon request).
- **How are boards tested?**
  Every bare board undergoes Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) and Flying Probe electrical testing for shorts and opens.

## Introduction

BuildPCBs AI is a developer-first hardware infrastructure platform that automates PCB validation, DFM analysis, quoting, and manufacturing orchestration.

We combine:
- AI-driven design validation
- Instant DFM (Design for Manufacturing) feedback
- Automated quoting
- Manufacturing partner routing
- Programmatic API access

Our goal is simple:
Hardware, deployed like software.

## Quickstart

### How do I get started?
1. Create an account.
2. Verify your email.
3. Create a new project.
4. Upload your Gerber files and BOM.
5. Review AI validation report.
6. Confirm manufacturing order.

You can go from upload → production-ready in minutes.

### What do I need before uploading?
- Gerber files (RS-274X or X2 recommended)
- Drill file (.drl or Excellon)
- BOM (CSV, XLSX, or JSON)
- Pick & Place file (optional but recommended for assembly)

### Can I start without Gerbers?
Yes.
You can:
- Upload KiCad project files
- Upload Altium exports
- Import ODB++
- Use our upcoming AI schematic-to-PCB generator

## Core Platform Features

### What is AI-Driven DFM?
Our system analyzes:
- Trace width
- Copper spacing
- Annular ring size
- Via dimensions
- Layer stack alignment
- Solder mask clearance
- Silkscreen overlap
- Drill tolerances

You receive a pass/fail report plus suggested corrections.

### What makes BuildPCBs different from traditional board houses?
Traditional manufacturers:
- Review manually
- Provide delayed feedback
- Require email communication

BuildPCBs:
- Instant automated analysis
- Structured error reporting
- Real-time quote updates
- API-driven manufacturing

### Is this a PCB design tool?
No.
We are not replacing KiCad or Altium.
We are the infrastructure layer between: EDA → Manufacturing → Logistics

## Technical Specifications

### What are the minimum trace/space requirements?
Standard: 3mil / 3mil
Advanced HDI: 2mil / 2mil (upon engineering review)

### What copper thicknesses are supported?
- 1oz standard
- 2oz heavy copper
- Custom stackups available on request

### How many layers are supported?
- 2-layer
- 4-layer
- 6-layer
- 8-layer
- 10+ layer custom builds

### What board thicknesses are available?
- 0.6mm
- 0.8mm
- 1.0mm
- 1.6mm (standard)
- Custom thickness available

### What surface finishes are supported?
- HASL (Lead-Free)
- ENIG
- Immersion Silver
- OSP

### What file formats are supported?
- Gerber RS-274X
- Gerber X2
- ODB++
- Excellon drill
- CSV BOM
- XLSX BOM
- KiCad native exports
- Altium exports

### Do you validate impedance-controlled designs?
Yes.
You can specify impedance requirements in your stackup, and our system verifies trace geometry against standard impedance models.

### Can I run simulations before manufacturing?
Yes. We support:
- Basic electrical rule checks
- Layer consistency analysis
- Clearance analysis
- Thermal region detection (beta)

Advanced signal integrity simulation coming soon.

## Manufacturing & Assembly

### Do you offer PCB Assembly (PCBA)?
Yes. We provide SMT assembly, Through-hole assembly, Mixed assembly, and Full turnkey sourcing.

### Do you source components?
Yes. We integrate with Digi-Key, Mouser, LCSC, and Arrow. Component availability is validated during quote.

### What is Box Build?
Box Build includes PCB assembly, Enclosure integration, Cable harnesses, Mechanical mounting, and Final testing.

### What are typical lead times?
Prototypes: 2–4 business days
Small batch production: 5–10 business days
Large volume: Based on supply chain availability

### Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We ship globally via DHL, FedEx, and UPS.

### Can I track my order?
Yes. You receive Manufacturing status, Assembly status, Shipping tracking, and Delivery ETA in the dashboard.

## Pricing & Quoting

### How are quotes calculated?
Pricing is based on Layer count, Board dimensions, Quantity, Surface finish, Copper weight, Assembly complexity, and Component sourcing risk. Quotes update instantly when you modify parameters.

### Is there a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
No strict MOQ. Prototype runs start at 1–5 units.

### Are there setup fees?
No hidden fees. All pricing is transparent in the quote breakdown.

## API & Developer Integration

### Is there a BuildPCBs API?
Yes. You can Upload files programmatically, Trigger DFM analysis, Generate quotes, Create manufacturing orders, and Track production status.

### What does authentication look like?
Bearer token authentication.
Example:
Authorization: Bearer bp_live_xxxxxxxxx

### Base API URL
https://api.buildpcbs.ai

### Example: Trigger Quote
POST /v1/quotes

Body:
{
  "projectId": "abc123",
  "quantity": 100,
  "assembly": true
}

### Can I automate production from CI/CD?
Yes. BuildPCBs is designed for hardware teams shipping rapidly. You can integrate manufacturing into your pipeline.

## Security & Compliance

### Are my designs confidential?
Yes. End-to-end encryption, Secure storage, Optional NDA agreement, and Private manufacturing routing.

### Do you support ITAR or restricted builds?
Enterprise customers can request controlled routing.

## $BUILDers Ecosystem

### What is the $BUILD token?
The $BUILD token is part of our community incentive layer. It is not required to use BuildPCBs AI.

### What is the Anti-Rug Dashboard?
A transparency system showing Liquidity locks, Token supply, and Distribution milestones.

### How does vesting work?
You can view token unlock schedule inside the dashboard under $BUILDers.

## AI PCB Generation (Beta)

### Can AI generate a PCB from a prompt?
Yes (Beta).
Example: "Design a 5V USB-C regulated power board with status LED."
System generates: Schematic draft, PCB layout, BOM suggestion, DFM pre-check.

### Can I edit the AI-generated board?
Yes. You can export to KiCad, Altium, and ODB++.
